cost_basis: Level L1. Estimate 9.52 core-min from a MEASURED per-cell-step rate at THIS level under the frozen configuration (the pre-freeze probe ran all three levels to their own endTime). Per-level cap 30 core-min, >=3x the estimate; running-total cap 540. endTime 0.080 s is derived A PRIORI FROM GEOMETRY ALONE -- ~20 upstream acoustic traverses of the 0.85 m subsonic section at c-u ~ 220 m/s -- so no observed settling time enters it. Serial RANKS=1 by supervisor ruling: parallel would cut wall time without cutting core-minutes, at the price of decomposePar/reconstructPar machinery that would INVALIDATE the section 12 path evidence established on disk. $0.154 DERIVED at $0.0513/core-h owner-stated -- NOT measured.
_remedy: Branch (b) of VMFL046-R2's freeze pre-committed a NUMERICS change. R2 graded NOT A RESULT (row #57) because L3 hunted at 184x the plateau threshold -- a LIMIT CYCLE, confirmed by a flat-to-rising envelope over 54000 iterations, an 80%-of-variance single 4208-iteration mode, residuals carrying the same period, and an INVISCID control hunting at 20 cells with no physical unsteadiness mechanism available to it.
_probe: THE PRE-FREEZE PROBE REFUTED THE APPROVED DESIGN AND REPLACED IT. Twelve rhoPimpleFoam configurations retaining R2's first-order upwind schemes ALL FAILED at t = 4.1-6.4 ms across maxCo {0.05..1.0}, nOuterCorrectors {2,3,4}, relaxation {0.5..1.0}, transonic yes/no, tight and widened limiters, cold start and restart. The control: maxCo 0.05, TEN TIMES finer than configurations that had already failed, still died at t = 4.11e-03 -- a step-size instability yields to a smaller step and this one does not. THE FINDING: the R2 shock profile is not stable under a physical time derivative; its steadiness at L1/L2 is a property of a relaxation iteration with no time derivative in it. Adding rho/dt does not damp that shock, it EXPOSES it. TVD (vanLeer) is therefore FORCED, not preferred; vanLeer over limitedLinear because it is measurably cheaper and carries NO FREE COEFFICIENT.
_margin: maxCo 1.0 was STABLE AT L1 and is REFUSED because it was not tested at L3 -- a deliberate ~2x cost paid for margin at the level that decides the verdict. Both of today's failures (rows #57 and #58) were fine-level instabilities the coarse meshes suppressed.
